teaching.spokenAnchor: Planning inspects the irregular metadata and prepares work assignments and temporary storage. Running consumes that plan with the query and cache payload. Compatible calls can reuse prepared work. This split keeps repeated kernel execution separate from the work needed to understand a new batch.
teaching.moment: Connect irregular sequence metadata to per-CTA work queues and the later merge map.
teaching.scope: This is the paper’s scheduler, not a guarantee that every current wrapper replans or supports graph replay identically.
teaching.caption: Plan CTA work queues and a reduction map, then merge partial attention outputs.
